$comment: PROJECT TRUTH — committed on purpose. GAS-Core adr/0004: per-env identifiers of external
resources live here, where a wrong ID is caught in review once instead of on every machine.
Machine truth and secrets (clasp auth, admin secrets, API tokens, the deploymentId cache the
deploy writes back) stay in the gitignored local.settings.json — see local.settings.json.example.
None of the IDs below is a secret: a scriptId appears in every Apps Script editor URL, and a
sheetId in every spreadsheet URL. Access is controlled by Drive sharing, not by their obscurity.
envs.<target>.scriptId / .sheetId are read by gas-deploy (>= v1.4.0).
envs.<target>.static and staticHosts are read by this project's tools/static-pages.js, which
composes gas-static's config from them; gas-deploy ignores them.
